Start: Sefris of the Hidden Ways (battlefield); Radiant Solar (battlefield); Progenitor Mimic (battlefield: as a copy of Radiant Solar); Sakashima's Student (battlefield: as a copy of Radiant Solar)

Color identity: GWUB | Bracket: Exhibition | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal
Produces: Near-infinite creature ETB; Near-infinite creature LTB; Near-infinite death triggers; Near-infinite lifeloss for all players; Near-infinite creature sacrifice triggers
Start: Sefris of the Hidden Ways (battlefield); Radiant Solar (battlefield); Moritte of the Frost (battlefield: as a copy of Radiant Solar); Phyrexian Metamorph (battlefield: as a copy of Radiant Solar)
Prerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
  You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
Steps: Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
  When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Moritte of the Frost and Phyrexian Metamorph each trigger.
  Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
  Resolve the Moritte of the Frost trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
  Resolve the Phyrexian Metamorph trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
  If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
  Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

## Combo 728-1315-3234-3293

Color identity: GWUB | Bracket: Exhibition | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite +1/+1 counters on a creature; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite death triggers; Infinite landfall triggers; Infinite lifegain; Infinite lifegain triggers; Infinite self-mill; Return all nonland permanents from your graveyard to the battlefield
Start: Emeria Shepherd (battlefield); World Shaper (battlefield); Zuran Orb (battlefield); Grimgrin, Corpse-Born (battlefield)
Prerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
Steps: Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing a land.
  Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
  Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing World Shaper.
  When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
  When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
  Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
  Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
  Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
  Repeat
Notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

  When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
  When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
  Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
  Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
  Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
  Repeat
Notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

  Repeat.

  Repeat from step 4.
